Sponsor, Exhibitor & Advertising Opportunities - National Association of Public Insurance Adjusters

###### 2023-2024 NAPIA Prospectus

Please email info@napia.com for more information and availability of current opportunities.

Advertise in Consumer Claims Journal Showcase your business to insureds, adjusters, and others involved in the first-party property insurance claims community. Consumer Claims Journal is mailed to nearly 4,000 individuals and electronically sent to thousands more. The magazine is made available at numerous insurance industry events and featured indefinitely on the NAPIA website (click here to view).

Founding Members from Left to Right: Robert Goodman, William Goodman, Paul Cordish, Norman Goodman and Abe Hoffman.
